scope: Matched contraction and gamma-pipeline improvements on unchanged Symbolica 06906976. Physical factorization is retained; printed-output agreement and HEP component tests establish regression evidence, not term counts alone.

first_full_pair.scope: Retained initial pair. A contiguous shared-host transient raised unchanged parser/normalizer controls by about1.6x in the after run; the full driver was repeated after-before. Main full comparison uses that confirmation, while these original raw samples remain available.

phase_driver.scope: Public linked stages on73 fixtures/terminal outputs,16 original gamma inputs and3 embedded factored generic controls. Stage timings overlap and are not additive. Original and terminal gamma calls can take different paths.

methodology.wall: One warmup process, then three measured processes. Six batches per process; entire wall time divided by total traces. Includes process startup, parsing/input normalization, trace4, sorting, count printing, drop and shutdown. Polynomial printing and exact checks excluded.
methodology.cpu: FORM internal timer covers trace4 plus .sort after input preparation; median last five of six batches, divided by traces per batch; median across three measured processes. Millisecond timer resolution applies per batch.
methodology.counts: Generated terms count StoreTerm submissions to sorter; sorted terms count final monomials after trace4+.sort. Neither is peak resident terms. Separate untimed run writes normalized input and complete polynomial.
methodology.scope: Independent p_i vectors and explicit4D Lorentz indices a,b,c,d,mu_i. No numeric/on-shell specialization. FORM fully normalizes external metrics before trace4. Idenso input construction is excluded from its timer; amortized FORM wall includes parsing/input preparation.
methodology.host: Shared host; CPU3 affinity inherited by child processes. Results are measurements, not a claim of equivalence based on term counts.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, statistics, subprocess, time

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
INPUTS = json.load(open(ROOT / "inputs.json"))
FORM = INPUTS["form_executable"]
HISTORICAL = json.load(open(ROOT / "historical-polynomials.json"))
REPETITIONS = {
    "order_sensitive_12": 600,
    "external_metrics_12": 600,
    "ordinary_odd_8": 3000,
    "ordinary_even2_8": 5000,
    "ordinary_even4_10": 400,
    "ordinary_cyclic_12": 150,
    "axial_odd_8": 3000,
    "axial_even4_10": 1000,
    "axial_crossing_12": 1500,
    "free_8": 600,
    "free_12": 40,
    "axial_12": 150,
    "axial_6": 3000,
    "axial_8": 1500,
    "axial_10": 500,
}
records = []
for case in INPUTS["cases"]:
    count_path = ROOT / f"{case['case']}-counts.frm"
    count_path.write_text(case["counts_program"])
    counted = subprocess.run(
        [FORM, str(count_path)], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True
    )
    (ROOT / f"{case['case']}-counts.log").write_text(counted.stdout)
    counts_match = re.search(
        r"Generated terms\s*=\s*(\d+)\s+F\s+Terms in output\s*=\s*(\d+)\s+trace4 Bytes",
        counted.stdout,
    )
    assert counts_match, (case["case"], counted.stdout)
    assert tuple(map(int, counts_match.groups())) == (
        case["generated_terms"],
        case["sorted_terms"],
    )
    normalized = re.search(
        r"^NORMALIZED_INPUT=(.*?)(?=^    trace4,1;)", counted.stdout, re.M | re.S
    )
    assert normalized, case["case"]
    case["normalized_input"] = "".join(normalized.group(1).split()).removesuffix(";")
    polynomial_match = re.search(
        r"^RESULT=(.*?)(?=^    [.]end)", counted.stdout, re.M | re.S
    )
    assert polynomial_match, case["case"]
    polynomial = "".join(polynomial_match.group(1).split()).removesuffix(";")
    polynomial_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(polynomial.encode()).hexdigest()
    historical = HISTORICAL.get(case["case"])
    if historical:
        assert polynomial == historical["polynomial"], case["case"]
    n = REPETITIONS[case["case"]]
    program = (
        "Off Statistics;\n"
        + INPUTS["header"]
        + f"""#do batch=1,6
#do j=1,{n}
Local F`j'={case["expression"]};
#enddo
.sort
#reset timer
trace4,1;
.sort
#write "BATCH_CPU_MS=`timer_'"
#$n=termsin_(F1);
#write "TERMS=%$",$n
Drop;
.sort
#enddo
.end
"""
    )
    path = ROOT / f"{case['case']}-timing.frm"
    path.write_text(program)
    wall = []
    cpu = []
    raw_cpu = []
    raw_logs = []
    for sample in range(4):
        started = time.perf_counter_ns()
        p = subprocess.run(
            [FORM, "-q", str(path)],
            cwd=ROOT,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True,
        )
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / (n * 6)
        path.with_suffix(f".{sample}.log").write_text(p.stdout)
        raw_logs.append(p.stdout)
        times = list(map(int, re.findall(r"BATCH_CPU_MS=(\d+)", p.stdout)))
        counts = list(map(int, re.findall(r"TERMS=(\d+)", p.stdout)))
        assert len(times) == 6 and counts == [case["sorted_terms"]] * 6, (times, counts)
        if sample:
            wall.append(elapsed)
            cpu.append(statistics.median(times[1:]) * 1e6 / n)
            raw_cpu.append(times)
    record = dict(
        case=case["case"],
        idenso_case="free_trace_8" if case["case"] == "free_8" else case["case"],
        expression=case["expression"],
        normalized_input=case["normalized_input"],
        generated_terms=case["generated_terms"],
        sorted_terms=case["sorted_terms"],
        traces_per_batch=n,
        batches_per_process=6,
        wall_ns_samples=wall,
        wall_ns_median=statistics.median(wall),
        cpu_ns_samples=cpu,
        cpu_ns_median=statistics.median(cpu),
        raw_batch_cpu_ms=raw_cpu,
        timing_program=program,
        raw_timing_output=raw_logs,
        counts_program=case["counts_program"],
        counts_output=(ROOT / f"{case['case']}-counts.log").read_text(),
        polynomial_sha256=polynomial_sha256,
        historical_polynomial_identical=True if historical else None,
        historical_polynomial_sha256=historical["polynomial_sha256"]
        if historical
        else None,
    )
    records.append(record)
    summary = dict(
        schema_version=1,
        date="2026-09-24",
        form_executable=FORM,
        form_version=INPUTS["version"],
        form_executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(FORM).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        source_url="https://github.com/form-dev/form/blob/v5.0.0/sources/opera.c",
        source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(
            Path("/tmp/trace-intermediate-form/form-5.0.0/sources/opera.c").read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest(),
        cpu=3,
        methodology=dict(
            wall="One warmup process, then three measured processes. Six batches per process; entire wall time divided by total traces. Includes process startup, parsing/input normalization, trace4, sorting, count printing, drop and shutdown. Polynomial printing and exact checks excluded.",
            cpu="FORM internal timer covers trace4 plus .sort after input preparation; median last five of six batches, divided by traces per batch; median across three measured processes. Millisecond timer resolution applies per batch.",
            counts="Generated terms count StoreTerm submissions to sorter; sorted terms count final monomials after trace4+.sort. Neither is peak resident terms. Separate untimed run writes normalized input and complete polynomial.",
            scope="Independent p_i vectors and explicit4D Lorentz indices a,b,c,d,mu_i. No numeric/on-shell specialization. FORM fully normalizes external metrics before trace4. Idenso input construction is excluded from its timer; amortized FORM wall includes parsing/input preparation.",
            host="Shared host; CPU3 affinity inherited by child processes. Results are measurements, not a claim of equivalence based on term counts.",
        ),
        records=records,
    )
    (ROOT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(
        f"{case['case']:26} {case['generated_terms']:5} -> {case['sorted_terms']:5}; wall {record['wall_ns_median'] / 1000:9.3f} us, CPU {record['cpu_ns_median'] / 1000:9.3f} us",
        flush=True,
    )

if (ROOT / "validation.json").exists():
    summary["validation"] = {
        "provenance": "Historical FORM inputs are unchanged. This run freshly checks generated/sorted counts, verifies exact polynomial equality for twelve historical cases, and remeasures timing.
